This log persists across runs and is never archived with the work-id. Adjudicate each lesson before banking it — the playbook holds open problems you are carrying forward, not a log of everything learned. If a lesson is understood and fixable now, APPLY it this run (make the bounded edit, record it in AGENT_FEEDBACK) and do not add a playbook entry at all; a lesson goes in the bank (an add) ONLY because it needs to be re-observed to be understood, and every add must carry a bank_reason saying what re-observation will clarify.
